title: next/image generates wrong srcset when used in component library with priority flag

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: please verify canary
labels.description: Please verify the issue with the latest canary branch.

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information


    Operating System:
      Platform: darwin
      Arch: x64
      Version: Darwin Kernel Version 21.5.0: Tue Apr 26 21:08:22 PDT 2022; root:xnu-8020.121.3~4/RELEASE_X86_64
    Binaries:
      Node: 14.20.0
      npm: 7.19.1
      Yarn: 1.22.19
      pnpm: 7.5.2
    Relevant packages:
      next: 12.2.4-canary.12
      eslint-config-next: 12.2.2
      react: 17.0.2
      react-dom: 17.0.2


### What browser are you using? (if relevant)

_No response_

### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant)

next start

### Describe the Bug

When using `next/image` in a component library with `priority` and custom `devicesSizes`, the custom `deviceSizes` are ignored for production runs. The generated `srcset` contains the default widths instead of the custom ones.

Similar issues have been reported previously (https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/33228, https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/31065), but the implemented fix (https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/33559) doesn't resolve the issue described above.

I've managed to create a failing test (see https://github.com/vercel/next.js/compare/canary...johnnyomair:next.js:wrong-srcset-for-node_modules), but I'm not sure whether I should create a PR for a failing test.

### Expected Behavior

The custom `devicesSizes` specified in `next.config.js` are used for `next/image` when using `priority`.

### Link to reproduction

https://github.com/johnnyomair/next.js/tree/wrong-srcset-for-node_modules

### To Reproduce

1. Checkout repo
2. Install dependencies `pnpm install`
3. Build `pnpm build`
4. Run test: `pnpm testheadless --testPathPattern "integration" -t "should apply srcset from image config for node_modules when using priority"`
